title: Partial Evidence & Scope-Limited Truth — meaning envelope, four region verdicts, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTS

source.source_reference: Shawn's explicit teaching, main chat, 2026-10-10. Filed same-evening per his standing law: his word IS the verification (Verification Law); filed immediately, not queued.

intelligence.essence: Never claim more than the evidence establishes; never discard what the evidence proves. Every claim is evaluated against its meaning envelope — the region of conditions where the evidence actually applies — with four region verdicts: the evidence can fully support, partially support, not support, or be undetermined for the claim. PARTIALLY_SUPPORTS is a first-class verdict, not a failed SUPPORTS: it says exactly which part of the envelope the evidence covers and which part it doesn't. This is the law against both overclaiming ('tested on one node' → 'works everywhere') and underclaiming (ignoring what was genuinely proven).

human_view.meaning: Say exactly what was proven — no more, no less. If the evidence covers half the claim, say 'half,' name which half, and don't pretend about the rest.
human_view.why_it_matters: The whole stack's honesty bottleneck. Every inflated 'works' and every discarded genuine result passes through this gate.

simple_view.meaning: Say exactly what was proven — no more, no less. If the evidence covers half the claim, say 'half,' name which half, and don't pretend about the rest.

naya_view.directive: Evaluate every claim against its meaning envelope; assign one of the four region verdicts. PARTIALLY_SUPPORTS must name the covered and uncovered regions. Never promote a partial verdict by dropping the uncovered part.

ai_view.specification: verdict(claim, evidence, envelope) ∈ {SUPPORTS, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTS(covered, uncovered), DOES_NOT_SUPPORT, UNDETERMINED}. Promotion requires the claim to fit inside the covered region.
ai_view.directive: Follow as written. This is law, not guidance.

machine_view.spec_only: Spec-only by design; live KNOW/LAW/ACT wiring parked for the Human Director's word. No production claim.
machine_view.test_evidence: Scope-limited-truth spec L1: 158/158 tests (meaning envelope, four region verdicts, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTS as first-class).

intelligence.learning_lesson: Standing example: the 2026-10-10 qualification sandbox proved the lesson mechanism on one harness — scope-limited truth forbids reading it as 'the brain learns.'
decisions: Shawn's word ratifies the teaching. His word IS the verification; no second verification of the lesson itself is permitted (Verification Law).

intelligence.falsifier: Falsified if a claim is found asserted beyond its covered region, or genuine partial support is discarded.
